title: Important: frr security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description:
FRRouting is free software that manages TCP/IP based routing protocols. It supports BGP4, OSPFv2, OSPFv3, ISIS, RIP, RIPng, PIM, NHRP, PBR, EIGRP and BFD. 

Security Fix(es):

* frr: FRRouting: Denial of Service via crafted BGP UPDATE message (CVE-2026-37460)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Zebra is not installing the route in the kernel after flapping one of the physical link on the ocp worker node. [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-152300)

* frr triggers SELinux denials when reading root's Python site-packages directory on Rocky Linux-9 (JIRA:Rocky Linux-176258)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
